items.title: John Best interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: I got into Europe with the Ray Conniff band you know.

ctx.x: Did you get into Europe with the Donahue band?
Before that band. After I mean I got into Europe with the Ray Conniff band you know. And also, South America.
Well the Swing Era, I wanted to back track just a minute. When you joined Glenn Miller in ‘39, can you recall who else was in that band at that time?
